detail.longDescription: I get a strange ick listening to senior developers, who spent years working on commercial projects, that they "don't even check what goes to production from AI anymore". This appeared almost in-line with another quote "We don't do tests, because they are a waste of time now". I understand the fascination with automated workflows and night-shift AI workers... but you got to have some decency and control in what you ship. # programming # agenticai # development # security
